kube_context.description: Switch the current kubectl context to a named cluster.

aws_profile.description: Set the active AWS profile for this shell.

brew_service.description: Start, stop or restart a Homebrew service.

action.description: What to do with the service.

open_pr.description: Open the pull request for the current git branch in the browser.

open_file.description: Open a file in the editor, optionally at a line number.

line.description: The line number to jump to, if any.

kill_port.description: Kill the process listening on a TCP port.

show_port.description: Show which process is listening on a TCP port, without killing it.

checkout_branch.description: Check out the git branch whose name contains the given text.

git_changes_since.description: Show what changed in this repository since a point in time.

since.description: A time expression such as 'yesterday', 'last week' or '3 days ago'.

tail_service_log.description: Follow the log of a Homebrew service.

disk_usage.description: Show what is taking up disk space in a directory.

path.description: The directory; the current one if omitted.
